label: 城市夜访
description: V5 写实模板：城市夜访（夜间街头采访，风格 film_interview）

acts.name: 第 1 幕
acts.visual: Wide establishing shot at 11pm: the stairway mouth of a subway station glows warm, a stream of tired commuters climbs up into the neon night, the camera slowly pushes in through light drizzle.

acts.name: 第 2 幕
acts.text: 这么晚还在街上走的人，心里多半都装着点事儿。
acts.visual: Medium shot of a 38-year-old Chinese man in a dark wool coat standing at the curb under a street lamp, speaking to camera; wet asphalt reflects red and cyan neon signs, passersby blur in the background.

acts.name: 第 3 幕
acts.text: 刚下班，出来走一走，才觉得这一天属于自己。
acts.visual: Close medium shot of a 27-year-old Chinese programmer in a grey hoodie and headphones, walking slowly along the wet street, neon light sliding across his tired face as he speaks.

acts.name: 第 4 幕
acts.visual: A 24-hour convenience store on a street corner, bright white interior light spilling onto the sidewalk, a customer pushes the glass door open, the camera glides past the entrance.

acts.name: 第 5 幕
acts.text: 夜里的便利店最诚实，谁饿了、谁睡不着，全写在脸上。
acts.visual: Inside the convenience store, a 34-year-old Chinese woman in a green work jacket behind the counter speaks while arranging goods; warm fluorescent light, shelves of snacks behind her.

acts.name: 第 6 幕
acts.text: 所以别怕晚归，街灯和便利店的热咖啡，都替我们留着。
acts.visual: Medium-wide shot of the host standing alone at the empty street corner, street lamps and the convenience store glowing behind him, he speaks to camera and gives a small smile.

scenes.label: 城市夜景街道
scenes.description: 真实中国城市夜景街道：湿沥青反光、霓虹招牌、路灯、远处行人与车流；适合街头采访与夜归 B-roll。

scenes.label: 地铁口
scenes.description: 真实地铁站出入口：台阶、暖黄灯光、晚高峰后的人流、街边霓虹与广告灯箱。

scenes.label: 24 小时便利店
scenes.description: 真实 24 小时便利店门口：玻璃门、店内明亮白光、货架、街边台阶，夜里是整条街最暖的一块光。

closing_broll.visual: Final wide shot rising above the night street: neon signs, wet asphalt and one late taxi passing, the city keeps its lights on.
